Verbatim repro reproduces exactly: 'F008 verbatim corr: 0.13290288791452182' with warning 'PPCA EM did not converge within 500 iterations (last relative change nan, tol 0.0001)'. Caveat I observed: the failure is RNG-init-sensitive -- an identical missing matrix imputed after other RNG-consuming calls converged fine (corr 0.846, rmse 0.00325, only the 3-empty-rows warning). So PPCA does not deterministically fail on this data, but the example's own seed path lands on a nan-divergent EM run, which still substantiates the rough-edge claim. Minor is fair.
